verifications.claim: The Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team has made four Final Four appearances in the NCAA Tournament in 1988, 1994, 1997, and 2001.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Can 2001 really be the last time the Wildcats showed up at the event?'; R2: 'The Wildcats have reached the Final Four of the NCAA tournament on five occasions (1988, 1994, 1997, 2001, and 2026)'; R3: 'Arizona is trying to close on its first Final Four since 2001'
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R3 imply four appearances up to 2001; R2 explicitly states five including 2026, creating contradiction on total number.

verifications.claim: All four Final Four appearances by the Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team occurred under head coach Lute Olson.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Tommy Lloyd becomes the only man to take Arizona to the Final Four not named Lute Olson'; R2: Final Four years 1988, 1994, 1997, 2001 detailed under Lute Olson sections (1983-2007).
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm the four listed appearances (pre-2026) were under Lute Olson.

verifications.reasoning: Direct match in R2 Final Fours results table.
